text:
Sam K.: Morning — kicking off Vectora POC. Customer wants to validate Vectora-13B (open variant) for chat/summarization. Two immediate asks: 1) compatibility scan (tokenizer, kv-cache, quant variants) 2) POC pricing + path to Dedicated if they scale. SLO target: ~200ms p95 on short prompts, can tolerate higher for long sequences. Can someone pick this up?

Elaine C.: I can run a quick model-scan. Need example prompt distribution (avg/max seq length), and whether they require KMS + SOC2 in POC. Also: do they expect streaming / function-calling?

Sam K.: Good call. Example: 60% short (<=64 tokens), 30% medium (65-512), 10% long (512-2048). They want streaming and function calling later. SOC2 required; KMS likely (customer ops).

Miguel R.: Heads-up: Vectora uses SentencePiece with a few custom special tokens. If their tokenizer diverges from our catalog version we'll either ship a tokenizer adapter or re-tokenize client-side. KV-cache shape looks standard but we should confirm rotary embedding dims for optimized kernels. I'll kick off a local inference run.

Sam K.: thx. Quick config I used to repro locally: ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -d '{"model":"vectora-13b","input":"Summarize the following research note...","max_tokens":256,"stream":false}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

InfraBot: model-scan report for vectora-13b (job id vscan-8391)
- tokenizer: sentencepiece; 2 custom tokens detected -> adapter recommended
- kernels: rotary dims 64/128 (mixed) -> runtime patch needed for optimal kernels
- quant candidates: q4_0, q8_0 (q4_0 appears stable on fp16 sim)
- kv-cache layout: standard (no-op)
- security flags: no known licensing blockers (open), KMS integration required for Private.

Priya S.: Pricing question from AE: they expect ~10M tokens for a 4-week POC, streaming enabled. If performance looks good, they may commit to a Dedicated pool (8xA10s) within 3 months. What is a back-of-envelope for hosted cost vs reserved?

Elaine C.: Rough hosted estimate for 10M tokens on vectora-13b (q4_0 average): ~$1,200 for generation tokens + infra overhead. Dedicated reserved pricing depends on region and commit; ballpark monthly list for 8xA10s ~ $35k/month infra; we usually offer a POC discount (50-70%) for first 1-2 months plus onboarding credits. I'll sync with pricing.

Miguel R.: Technical blocker list: tokenizer adapter (dev ~2x dev-days), runtime kernel patch (1-2 dev-days + QA), create q4_0 quant variant for catalog (1 dev-day + quant validation). Canary rollout steps below.

Miguel R.: Canary rollout suggestion: ```json
{
  "rollout": "canary",
  "traffic_split": {"vectora-13b-q4_0": 10, "vectora-13b-fp16": 90},
  "monitoring": ["latency_p95","error_rate","quality_regressions"],
  "fallback": "vectora-13b-fp16"
}
```

Sam K.: Perfect. Elaine — can you run pricing + legal (KMS + SOC2) check and confirm POC discount range? Miguel — please open an infra ticket for the kernel patch and tokenizer adapter with estimates. I'll send the customer a short checklist (sample prompts, test dataset, security contact) by EOD.

Elaine C.: On it. Also adding Security: link to security questionnaire for them -> https://redwood.ai/security/questionnaire (ask for org's SOC2 cert and KMS contact).

Miguel R.: Created infra ticket #INF-4812 for runtime patch + tokenizer adapter. ETA: 3 business days for dev + 2 days QA. Assigning to eng-runtime.

Priya S.: I'll draft POC SOW and include pricing options: hosted variable, 30-day discounted reserved trial, and Dedicated onboarding path. Will loop legal for the KMS language.

Sam K.: Action items summary: 1) Elaine -> pricing + security check (ETA 1 business day). 2) Miguel -> infra ticket + quant variant (INF-4812). 3) Priya -> POC SOW + AE communication. 4) Sam -> send customer checklist + ask for sample prompts/dataset.

Elaine C.: Adding: please upload a 500-sample prompt set to the shared drive (redwood://sales/vectora/poc/samples) so we can run quality regressions. :thumbsup:

Sam K.: will do. Thanks team :rocket:

Priya S.: pinging @account-team to prepare contract path if they opt for Dedicated after POC. :eyes:
